cards.name: Meletis Astronomer
cards.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal an enchantment card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

cards.name: Meletis Charlatan
cards.oracleText: {2}{U}, {T}: The controller of target instant or sorcery spell copies it. That player may choose new targets for the copy.

cards.name: Melee
cards.oracleText:
Cast this spell only during combat on your turn before blockers are declared.
You choose which creatures block this combat and how those creatures block.
Whenever a creature attacks and isn't blocked this combat, untap it and remove it from combat.

cards.name: Melek, Reforged Researcher
cards.oracleText:
Melek's power and toughness are each equal to twice the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
The first instant or sorcery spell you cast each turn costs {3} less to cast.

cards.name: Melek, Izzet Paragon
cards.oracleText:
Play with the top card of your library revealed.
You may cast instant and sorcery spells from the top of your library.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell from your library, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
